Explore county-by-county results from the November 3, 2026 general election in Georgia.

## Georgia — U.S. Senate

Hover over any county to inspect vote totals for **Jon Ossoff (DEM)** and **Mike Collins (REP)**, or use the top-right toggle to switch between **Vote Margin** and **Total Votes Cast**.

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(mapgl)
library(tigris)

# Read Georgia locality-level results for U.S. Senate
senate_counties <- read_csv("data/georgia/results_locality_20261103.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(contest == "US Senate") |>
  summarise(
    total_votes = sum(votes),
    ossoff_votes = sum(votes[party == "Dem"]),
    collins_votes = sum(votes[party == "Rep"]),
    .by = locality
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ossoff_pct = round(100 * ossoff_votes / total_votes, 1),
    collins_pct = round(100 * collins_votes / total_votes, 1),
    dem_margin = round(100 * (ossoff_votes - collins_votes) / total_votes, 1),
    margin_label = case_when(
      is.na(dem_margin) ~ "No votes reported",
      dem_margin > 0 ~ paste0("Ossoff +", dem_margin, "%"),
      dem_margin < 0 ~ paste0("Collins +", abs(dem_margin), "%"),
      TRUE ~ "Tied (0.0%)"
    )
  )

# Fetch Georgia county boundaries, reproject to WGS84, and join election data
counties_sf <- tigris::counties(state = "GA", cb = TRUE, year = 2020) |>
  st_transform(4326) |>
  left_join(senate_counties, by = c("NAMELSAD" = "locality")) |>
  mutate(
    hover_tip = paste0(
      "<strong>", NAMELSAD, "</strong><br>",
      "Margin: <strong>", coalesce(margin_label, "No votes"), "</strong><br>",
      "Jon Ossoff (DEM): ", coalesce(as.character(ossoff_pct), "0"), "% (", scales::comma(coalesce(ossoff_votes, 0)), ")<br>",
      "Mike Collins (REP): ", coalesce(as.character(collins_pct), "0"), "% (", scales::comma(coalesce(collins_votes, 0)), ")<br>",
      "Total County Votes: ", scales::comma(coalesce(total_votes, 0))
    )
  )

# Diverging red-white-blue scale for Ossoff vs. Collins margin
margin_pal <- interpolate_palette(
  data = counties_sf,
  column = "dem_margin",
  data_values = c(-60, -30, 0, 30, 60),
  colors = c("#b2182b", "#ef8a62", "#f7f7f7", "#67a9cf", "#2166ac"),
  na_color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Sequential purple scale for county vote volume
volume_pal <- interpolate_palette(
  data = counties_sf,
  column = "total_votes",
  data_values = c(2000, 10000, 30000, 100000, 300000),
  colors = c("#edf8fb", "#b3cde3", "#8c96c6", "#8856a7", "#4d004b"),
  na_color = "#d9d9d9"
)

# Build interactive MapLibre county map
maplibre(
  style = carto_style("positron"),
  bounds = counties_sf,
  height = "680px"
) |>
  add_source(id = "ga_counties", data = counties_sf) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "Vote Margin (DEM - REP)",
    source = "ga_counties",
    fill_color = margin_pal$expression,
    fill_opacity = 0.84,
    fill_outline_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)",
    tooltip = "hover_tip",
    hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1, fill_outline_color = "#111111")
  ) |>
  add_fill_layer(
    id = "Total Votes Cast",
    source = "ga_counties",
    visibility = "none",
    fill_color = volume_pal$expression,
    fill_opacity = 0.84,
    fill_outline_color = "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25)",
    tooltip = "hover_tip",
    hover_options = list(fill_opacity = 1, fill_outline_color = "#111111")
  ) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "U.S. Senate Margin",
    values = c("Collins +60%", "Collins +30%", "Even", "Ossoff +30%", "Ossoff +60%"),
    colors = margin_pal$colors,
    type = "continuous",
    position = "bottom-left",
    layer_id = "Vote Margin (DEM - REP)",
    add = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "Total County Votes",
    values = c("2,000", "10,000", "30,000", "100,000", "300,000+"),
    colors = volume_pal$colors,
    type = "continuous",
    position = "bottom-left",
    layer_id = "Total Votes Cast",
    add = TRUE
  ) |>
  add_layers_control(
    position = "top-right",
    layers = c("Vote Margin (DEM - REP)", "Total Votes Cast"),
    collapsible = FALSE,
    mode = "single"
  )
```
